Write an HTML report of an analysis

Source: R/report.R
design_report.Rd

Builds a self-contained HTML report of a fitted design: a materials and methods paragraph ready to adapt, descriptive statistics, the assumption checks with their grade, the analysis of variance with a draft of the results, the means with their letters, trend analysis of quantitative factors, simple effects of two-factor interactions, figures embedded as vector graphics, appendices with the pairwise comparisons and the data, and how to cite the software. Open it in any web browser and print it to PDF from there (A4 page style included).

Usage

design_report(
  fit,
  file = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  authors = "",
  affiliation = "",
  trial = "",
  objective = "",
  units = "",
  method = "tukey",
  alpha = 0.05,
  control = NULL,
  assumptions = TRUE,
  figures = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  data = FALSE,
  cite = TRUE,
  open = FALSE
)

Arguments

fit

An "ad_anova" object from design_anova().

file

Output file (.html); NULL only returns the HTML.

title, authors, affiliation, trial, objective

Texts for the head of the report.

units

Units of the response, for the methods paragraph.

method, alpha

Mean-separation procedure and significance level (see compare_means()).

control

Control level for method = "dunnett".

assumptions, figures, pairwise, data, cite

Include those sections.

open

Open the report in the browser when it is written.

Value

The HTML text, invisibly.

Examples

fit <- design_anova(maize_nitrogen, "Yield_t_ha", "Nitrogen_kg_ha", block = "Block")
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
design_report(fit, f, title = "Nitrogen rates in maize", units = "t/ha", figures = FALSE)
file.exists(f)
#> [1] TRUE
